description: Read-only, named query profiles. Values are bound parameters, never string interpolated.

gateway.query: SELECT event_time, level, message, correlation_id, order_id FROM gateway_logs WHERE order_id = :business_id ORDER BY event_time

orders.query: SELECT event_time, level, message, correlation_id, order_id FROM order_logs WHERE order_id = :business_id ORDER BY event_time

payments.query: SELECT event_time, level, message, correlation_id, payment_id FROM payment_logs WHERE order_id = :business_id ORDER BY event_time

inventory.query: SELECT event_time, level, message, correlation_id, sku FROM inventory_logs WHERE order_id = @business_id ORDER BY event_time

shipping.query: SELECT event_time, level, message, correlation_id, shipment_id FROM shipping_logs WHERE order_id = @business_id ORDER BY event_time

audit.query: SELECT event_time, level, message, correlation_id, actor FROM audit_logs WHERE order_id = :business_id ORDER BY event_time
